title: Workplace Risk Assessment Record
description: Structured risk assessment record per OSHA-KR Article 36 (위험성평가 실시). Documents hazard identification, risk scoring, and control measures for workplace tasks.

assessment_scope.description: Work area, task, or process being assessed

industry_profile.description: Industry sector. Canonical forms: 'meddevice' and 'pharmaceutical'. The values 'medical_device' and 'pharma' are DEPRECATED aliases retained only for backward compatibility with records authored before vocabulary unification — do not use them in new or updated records; migrate to the canonical forms on next write. Vocabulary otherwise covers every value used in `applicable_industries` across `workflows/domains/functional/risk-assessment/*/schema.yaml` plus the KNOWN_INDUSTRIES vocabulary in `scripts/co-safety/domain-config.ts` (which still carries both alias forms until unified).

risk_level_before.description: Risk level before controls. Qualitative band derived from `risk_score_before` via the normative band table defined on that property.

risk_score_before.description: Numeric Likelihood x Severity product (1-25 scale) before controls, alongside the qualitative risk_level_before band. Added v1.1.0 to enable quantitative trend analysis and cross-record aggregation. Normative band table (single source of truth for all score/band fields in this schema): 1-5 Low, 6-12 Medium, 13-19 High, 20-25 Critical; any score >= 13 (High or Critical) requires escalation (`escalate: true`, SWM review).

status.description: Implementation status. Canonical lifecycle vocabulary unified with risk-register-record.json `control_status` in v3.1.0: planned -> in_progress -> implemented, with overdue for missed target dates and not_required / na for excluded controls.

risk_level_after.description: Residual risk level after controls. Qualitative band derived from `risk_score_after` via the normative band table defined on `risk_score_before`.

risk_score_after.description: Numeric Likelihood x Severity product (1-25 scale) after controls, alongside the qualitative risk_level_after band. Added v1.1.0. Bands identical to the normative table defined on `risk_score_before`.

overall_risk_level.description: Highest risk level across all assessed hazards

worker_communication_date.description: Date risk assessment results were communicated to workers (per Art 36 + Art 29)

training_record_ref.description: Reference to training-record.json for risk assessment communication training

incident_ref.description: Reference to the originating incident/RCA record (e.g. memory/incidents/ or FIND-YYYY-NNNN), required in practice when assessment_type is 'post_incident'. Added v1.1.0.

related_assessment_ref.description: References to related specialist assessment outputs (e.g. fall-hazard-assessor, ess-fire-risk-assessor, psm-agent HAZOP/PHA records) that inform or overlap with this assessment. Added v1.1.0. Nullable union normalized to plain array in v3.0.0 (field is optional; absence conveys none).

legal_basis.description: Multi-source legal basis. Primary: OSHA-KR Article 36 (risk assessment obligation). Adjacent laws may include: SAPA Article 4 (safety and health assurance obligation — management system must include risk assessment), SAPA Article 5 (safety and health assurance obligation in contracted/outsourced work), MOEL workplace risk assessment guidelines (고용노동부 고시).
